metaTitle: Custom Unisex Pants & Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex pants shorts for your team or event. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Unisex pants and shorts are designed to fit a wide range of body types, making them a practical choice for corporate uniforms, event staff, or promotional giveaways. Unlike gender-specific cuts, these styles offer a relaxed fit that works for everyone, reducing the need to order separate men's and women's options. Popular choices like the Champion Adult Cotton Gym Short or Sport-Tek PosiCharge Competitor 7” Pocketed Short can be embroidered or screen printed with your logo for a cohesive look.
heroAltText: Custom unisex pants shorts with embroidered logo on pocket, available in multiple colors for bulk orders
